rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: RE-FIRE RESOLUTION CHECK (prior verdict REVISE, blocking): line 9 still prints the ONLY full stage-list 'loop' in this file, attributed by name — "the compound step closes Kieran Klaassen's loop: ideate → brainstorm → plan → work → review → polish → **compound** → repeat." Line 55 now reads "The last move of the loop you ran today, closing the bug's ticket outside the repo, is the homework" (was bare "The loop's last move"). Three independent signals now steer a sequential reader away from Klaassen's loop at line 55, not one: (a) content mismatch forces a re-parse — Klaassen's printed sequence ends in 'repeat,' so a reader who provisionally maps 'the loop' to Klaassen's hits an immediate contradiction ('closing the bug's ticket' is not 'repeat') and must look for another antecedent; (b) 'you ran today' is a first-person ownership/temporal marker no reader applies to a loop explicitly attributed to a named third party two sentences earlier — 'Klaassen's loop' and 'the loop you ran' read as different possessives on purpose; (c) module signposting supplies the alternate antecedent legitimately, per this compendium's own carve-out ('vocabulary the enclosing module file's signposting introduced... counts as prior context for the exercises and lectures it includes'): getting-going.md's Big Idea (lines 5-6, rendered before this file's transclusion inside '## Start here') already names 'the first compound loop... The fourth move, closing the bug's ticket outside the repo, runs as homework... The loop every module after this one rides on' — establishing bare 'the loop' = the module's own 4-move arc, homework-as-last-move included, before this file is ever reached in deck order. (Key Concepts' terser 'The loop is orient → fix → compound → close' sits AFTER this file in deck order and is not needed for the resolution to hold.) Verdict: the collision the prior instance correctly caught is resolved, not papered over — withdrawing the REVISE.
